question: Which silver whisper will you chase through the night?
intro_environment: A wide, misty marsh bathed in moonlight, with silver reeds, glimmering lily pads, and distant silhouettes of glowing trees, the sky a deep indigo sprinkled with stars.
intro_camera: Wide sweeping panorama from a low angle, horizon line slightly above the couple, capturing the expanse of marsh and moon.
intro_couple_action: The couple strolls along a narrow, winding path of glowing stones, eyes wide, map in hand, whispering plans.

choices.title: Luminous Lilypad Archipelago
choices.description: A network of giant, bioluminescent lily pads floating over a silver misty marsh, connected by translucent bridges.
choices.composition: Lateral sweeping line of lily pads with a single archway leading to a central glowing pavilion.
choices.camera: Low-angle close-up, slightly tilted to emphasize the height of the lily pads.
choices.dominant_palette: Soft teal, pale silver, moonlit lavender
choices.couple_action: The couple stands on a translucent bridge, one holding a lantern, the other pointing to the distant pavilion.

choices.title: Fungal Glow Cavern
choices.description: A vast underground cavern illuminated by towering mushroom bioluminescence, dripping stalactites.
choices.composition: Vertical depth with a central column of glowing mushrooms, leading to a lower cavern floor.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep forest green, amber glow, muted gray
choices.couple_action: The couple kneels at a mossy ledge, one holding a torch, the other sketching the fungi.

choices.title: Moonlit Tidefall
choices.description: A dramatic cliff overlooking moonlit tide pools, with waves crashing against jagged rocks.
choices.composition: Foreground cliff ledge, middle ground tide pools, background moonlit sea.
choices.camera: Wide shot from cliff edge, horizon line at the moon.
choices.couple_action: The couple stands on the ledge, one pointing at the waves, the other taking a photo.

choices.title: Sundown Mirage Oasis
choices.description: A shimmering desert oasis under a silver moon, with crystal-clear water and dunes.
choices.composition: Central oasis pool with surrounding dunes, a lone palm tree.
choices.camera: Medium shot from above, slightly angled, capturing the pool reflection.
choices.dominant_palette: Dusty gold, twilight blue, emerald green
choices.couple_action: The couple sits on a dune, sipping water, watching the moonlit reflection.
